_about: The Mindflayer's Lair (levels 18-30): the flayers answer each other's psychic call, the mind flayers are elites, and the Master Mindflayer in its sanctum darkens your mind as it weakens and calls its brood.

helpers.shout: A psychic shriek fills your skull: the brood comes!
A psychic shriek fills your skull: the brood comes!

patrols.why: a flayer moves between the warrens and the feeding chamber

bosses.why: the Master Mindflayer in its sanctum

mechanics.why: its mind blots out the light

mechanics.shout: The Master Mindflayer calls, and its brood crawls out of the walls!
